summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, and the party remains the favourite. The projected seat count is now 55-45, up from 54-46, which would mean Democrats gain control, and [[South Carolina]] is a newly predicted flip after a sharp rise for the Democrat Annie Andrews. In [[Iowa]], the Democrat Josh Turek also gained ground sharply, and the market sees that seat as a predicted flip.
summaries.governor: The biggest moves came in three races Polymarket odds show as predicted flips: [[Ohio]], [[Nevada]] and Georgia, where the Democrats Amy Acton, Aaron Ford and Keisha Lance Bottoms each saw their chances rise sharply. In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds also gained a good deal of ground in the market.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats' chances of winning House control rising by a sizable margin, with the party favoured to take the chamber. The market's projected seat count recently changed to 253-182, up from 251-184, a result in which Democrats gain control, and [[CO-05 (Colorado Springs & Fountain)]], [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]] and [[OH-10 (Dayton & Kettering)]] are newly predicted flips.
